chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl, from a man, from Muʿallā ibn Khunays, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام about a man who forgets a sajdah in his salat. He said: If he remembers it before his rukuʿ, he performs it and continues his salat; then he performs the two sajdahs of sahw after finishing. But if he remembers it after his rukuʿ, he repeats the salat, and forgetting a sajdah in the first two rakʿahs and the last two is the same.

What this report contains in his statement, 'If he remembers it after his rukuʿ, he repeats the salat,' admits two possibilities. One of them is that it refers to one who left both sajdahs together, for whoever is in this condition must repeat the salat; and for this reason he said, 'Forgetting the sajdah in the first two rakʿahs and the last two is the same,' meaning with respect to the two sajdahs together.

The second is that this is to be understood regarding a single sajdah, and that this ruling is specific to the first two rakʿahs; and that his statement, 'Forgetting the sajdah in the first two rakʿahs and the last two is the same,' is a new ruling concerning the two sajdahs together. And that which indicates the distinction that we have mentioned...

key_terms.أَعَادَ الصَّلَاةَ: he must repeat the entire salat
key_terms.السَّجْدَةَ: a single sajdah omitted during salat
key_terms.الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ: the last two rakʿahs of a four-rakʿah salat
key_terms.الْأُولَيَيْنِ: the first two rakʿahs of a four-rakʿah salat
key_terms.الْخَبَرُ: the transmitted hadith report under discussion
key_terms.رُكُوعِهِ: the bowing position in salat, which determines whether the omission can still be corrected without restarting
key_terms.سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ: the two prostrations of forgetfulness performed after salat

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets a sajdah in salat and only remembers after rukuʿ?
ai.summary: This passage discusses the legal ruling for one who forgets a sajdah during salat and whether the prayer must be continued or repeated depending on when the omission is remembered. It also records a juristic analysis of the report, distinguishing between forgetting one sajdah and forgetting both sajdahs, and between the first two and last two rakʿahs.
